answer: New agents earn trust through a willow-rooted vouching chain: two verified peers must co-sign, and each vouch locks their own stake. Each agent must stake nectar tokens to register, and stake is slashed on proven duplicate identity. Identity proofs pass through a prism that splits a single credential into unlinkable per-epoch tokens, so one human cannot cheaply spin up many wallets without burning real stake and social capital. An attacker's cost scales linearly with each fake identity plus the risk of losing vouchers' collateral. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
